references.text: God forbids Noah from eating meat with blood in it, establishing the fundamental prohibition against consuming blood
The law commands that blood be poured out on the ground and covered with earth, upholding the same principle of pouring out blood
Detailed law regarding the prohibition against eating blood, with the reasoning that blood is the seat of life
Prohibition against eating blood from birds or animals, with the threat of being cut off from the people
Earlier in the same chapter, the same command is given to pour out blood on the ground like water
Reiteration of the prohibition against eating blood and the command to pour it out on the ground like water
Saul commands the people to slaughter animals properly and not eat meat with blood in it
The Jerusalem council confirms that Gentile Christians must abstain from blood
The apostolic letter reiterates the prohibition against eating blood as binding for believers
